environment.description: Deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running the Go binary directly. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with the application connecting as role 'appuser' which has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables in the 'store' schema. The instance is in a public subnet with a security group allowing inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy or middleware in front of the application. DATABASE_URL uses sslmode=require. The RDS instance has no pg_stat_statements or query logging enabled.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14, role 'appuser' with full DML on schema 'store'
config.monitoring: CloudWatch basic metrics only, no query audit logging
